name: Proper Labeled Sample Compression
definition: The **Proper Labeled Sample Compression** is the minimum size of a labeled sample compression scheme whose reconstruction function always returns a member of $\mathcal{H}$.
graph_summary: Labeled compression size with reconstruction constrained to the class.
origin_references: This is the proper-reconstruction restriction of the standard labeled sample-compression framework of \cite{FW1995}.

p_monotonic.proof: Apply the proper labeled scheme to a projected-realizable labeled sample on the retained coordinates and restrict its reconstructed member of $\mathcal H$.  The restriction belongs to the projected class, remains consistent, and uses no additional labeled examples.

c_monotonic.proof: For a conditioned sample, append the fixed labeled coordinates, apply the original proper compression scheme, and restrict the reconstruction back to the fibre.
